supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: significant extension visible beyond the lateral margins of the orbits

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast; light-grey/tan muzzle area against dark-pigmented periocular and cheek regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: thick vertical dimension with a pronounced structural droop of the central lower lip

pinna_silhouette.outer_helix_geometry: rounded apex on the viewer's left; truncated/angular apex on the viewer's right
pinna_silhouette.severe_cartilage_deformities: apparent amputation or absence of the upper helix quadrant on the ear visible on the right side of the image

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive frontal cranial alopecia (balding) reaching the mid-crown; structural deformity of the upper right ear (viewer's right).
